_comment: Site-wide settings. base is the path prefix the site is served under: '/homekeep-site' on the GitHub address, '' once a custom domain is pointed at it (the deploy workflow sets SITE_BASE). apply_url is where every 'Apply in ten minutes' goes; app_store_url / play_store_url are empty until the listings exist and then appear on the Become a cleaner page automatically. company_line is empty until the company is registered (e.g. 'Registered in England and Wales, company number 12345678. Registered office: …'). noindex keeps search engines off the site while it is on the GitHub address.
